## Highlights
Showing the 12 most recent highlights from 27 user-facing changes.
### New
- Choose whether page cards animate when switching Spaces on Mac, with page motion enabled by default
### Improved
- Keep Space icons, backgrounds, and sidebar motion in sync - Slide page cards with Spaces and keep locked previews blurred - Show a quiet scroll indicator while scrolling and a glass arrow when more tabs are below - Follow your finger when swiping between Spaces on iPhone and iPad, with synchronized backgrounds and Space selection - Browse many Spaces with clear overflow arrows and rounded selection highlights on iPhone and iPad - Reduce processor usage while scrolling tabs in the desktop sidebar - Keep address completion responsive with large tab and history collections - Reduce extension preparation delays and reopen ready extensions without repeating startup waits
### Fixed
- Keep the floating sidebar responsive when switching to a locked Space - Keep essentials clear of the Space picker when the keyboard appears - Extend Space backgrounds behind mobile controls and show the scroll hint only when more tabs remain below
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.
